title: RNA 2′-OH modification with stable reagents enabled by nucleophilic catalysis
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,35749-35755
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA06314K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Eric T. Kool, Sumon Pratihar, Pavitra S. Thacker, Dipanwita Banerjee, Moon Jung Kim, Ryuta Shioi
RNA modification at 2′-OH commonly requires highly reactive reagents with short half-lives in water, challenging purification and limiting shelf life. Here, we describe moisture-stable reagents that react efficiently under nucleophilic catalysis.
